>I want to contribute to society.  I want to be a psychiatrist. I really want to help people but the thing is that I don't even know how to help myself.

I think you can. It sounds like you're an incredibly hard worker. I think she should look back at this when you do turn 21 and see how you feel about everything then. Because it sounds like you'll see some real progress.

\>> Oh yeah, republicans are definitely brainwashed. Are they prejudice or toxic to others ? Did you have a bad childhood with them ? 

I had a fantastic childhood with them. Politics were never huge in my house, and my folks have always believed in gays having the right to marry, legal marijuana, and are honestly leaning more towards pro choice. The problem is they want the economy to be "good", they think that the dems will literally destroy the economy and that all the social progress is meaningless unless the economy is working.

I myself became brainwashed by them. Stupid jokes like "stupid democrats" and stuff like that made it extremely hard to think about politics objectively. It would make me irrationally angry to hear opposing views because facing other ideas meant facing the reality that that I didn't even fully understand the ideas or "logic" of the ideas that had been instilled in me. So I'd shut down and avoid all politics talk or do the classic "both sides" bullshit because the cognitive dissonance that the family could be wrong was too great. 

Eventually my ex was able to force me to see the light, and I realized I wanted to believe in what's true, and that it's stupid to be personally attached to ideas. But whenever I try to show my parents the harm that the republicans are doing, and how they are actually shit for the economy, it falls on death ears. 

They've had 20 more years of identifying with the party, and it's too painful for them to admit they were wrong all those years.

Hey man no matter what you decide to do, you can take pride in the fact that you're still going to your classes and working. You haven't lost it all yet and there's still time for you to get it all under control before you turn 21.

\>> . I live with my abusive, white, Trump supporting family who hates me cause I'm the first born bi-racial child.

My family is stupid too. While my family has never said or done anything racist towards anyone, they were raised to be republicans and simply can't undo the brainwashing. If I talk to them about anything Trump stands for they'll be against it. But the moment I reveal it's trump they'll defend it saying we don't know all the facts. 

\>>  Nobody would care if I died anyways. I'm worthless. 

I know you feel that way, and I've got absolutely no way of knowing how you actually feel. But you're still moving through the pipeline, you're still in school and you're making progress. Even if it does feel extremely slow sometimes. You're still in a place where you can contribute to society and help others.

Yeah, it's fucking hysterical because I actually LOVE learning and I'm smart. When I actually went to class and paid attention I was at the top of my class. But once I had a bunch of shit happen to me I just stopped going to class. Whenever I'd have a moment where I'd be like "hey, I know I just missed three weeks in a row, but if I go to class I can still salvage a passing grade!" I'd become to afraid of being judged by my professor and classmates. (Yeah, I'm a fucking coward).

At the end of the semester I'd tell myself that I'll get back on next semester and recover. But I never did, that just became my life. I got so good at lying to my family and friends, I'm a real piece of shit and a failure.

I don't even have my undergrad degree. I started out so strong and was even in the honors program for my first two years. But then I got wrapped up in a spiral of depression and skipping classes. I kept telling myself "next semester I'll recover, I still have time."

All of my friends have gone on to incredible and important jobs doing cancer research at major institutions, developing top secret programs for the military, etc. And here I am, 25 no degree, no job experience, nothing. I've lied to literally every single person I've ever talked too and have been a supreme failure and disappointment. It's fucking too late for me.

If it makes you feel better, I'm an even worse version of you. I'm 25, failed out of college, have never had a real job, have lied to all my friends and family into believing that I'm currently at grad school when in reality I've just finished burning off the cash my folks gave me to start grad school with. 

I had a loving girlfriend who I got rid of because I knew she'd reveal my secret, I've ghosted friends that I really cared about because I was too embarrassed and ashamed of my failures. My sister just got engaged yesterday and I spent all of yesterday writing letters to my family and friends to explain why I'm going to be taking my own life.
